## Retrieval

| Strategy | recall@3 | recall@5 | recall@10 | MRR | nDCG@5 |
|----------|----------|----------|-----------|-----|--------|
| **Hybrid RRF** | 73.89% | 75.00% | 75.00% | 0.696 | 0.692 |
| **Vector-only** | 62.78% | 72.78% | 73.89% | 0.611 | 0.634 |
| **BM25-only** | 28.33% | 36.67% | 40.00% | 0.265 | 0.283 |
| **Agent tool calls** | 71.11% | 76.11% | 76.11% | 0.753 | 0.725 |

**Hybrid RRF outperforms vector-only by +3% and BM25-only by +105% on recall@5.**

**Agent tool calls vs. the pipeline's fixed retrieval: recall@5 76.11% vs. 75.00% (+1%), MRR 0.753 vs. 0.696.** Each entry gets one model turn in which the model chooses its `search_docs` queries; the sections those calls return are scored.

## Scope gate

- **Adherence:** 100% of 20 scope cases (0 miss)

---
*Thresholds enforced in CI: recall@5 >= 60%, MRR >= 0.30, hybrid >= vector-only, hybrid >= BM25-only.*

*Generation gate (mean on the 1-5 judge scale): faithfulness >= 4, relevance >= 4.5, citation_correctness >= 4, scope adherence >= 0.9. Citation correctness is gated: the prompt requires URLs copied verbatim from the excerpts, so invented URLs fail the build. The gate is enforced on the pipeline arm; agent-arm scores are reported alongside it (`--gate-agent` gates them too).*
